champions.name: Aatrox
champions.title: the Darkin Blade
champions.notes: Drain-tank bruiser who wins extended teamfights with Darkin Blade sweetspots and World Ender healing, and bullies immobile tanks in lane. Grievous Wounds, kiting ranged tops (Quinn, Kennen) and duelists with parries and dashes (Fiora, Irelia) blunt him.

champions.name: Ahri
champions.title: the Nine-Tailed Fox
champions.notes: Safe, mobile pick mage whose Charm into Spirit Rush finds kills and roams, and she blind-picks into almost any mid. She has no hard counters, but Twisted Fate out-roams her and assassins all-in her. She wants follow-up CC to convert charms.

champions.name: Akali
champions.title: the Rogue Assassin
champions.notes: Shroud-based skirmish assassin who bursts squishies and resets fights with Perfect Execution, and preys on immobile control mages. Point-and-click CC, Galio, Vex, Twisted Fate and true sight inside the shroud shut her down.

champions.name: Akshan
champions.title: the Rogue Sentinel
champions.notes: Roaming marksman-assassin whose camouflage, Heroic Swing and Comeuppance execute snowball skirmishes. Killing an ally's killer revives that ally. He falls off late, and Yasuo's wind wall and sustained melee all-ins beat him in lane.

champions.name: Alistar
champions.title: the Minotaur
champions.notes: Headbutt-Pulverize engage support with a strong level-2 all-in and a damage-reduction ult to front-line fights. He also peels by knocking divers away. Disengage, spell shields and range (Janna, Morgana, Senna, Sona) blunt his engages.

champions.name: Ambessa
champions.title: Matriarch of War
champions.notes: Energy-based dive bruiser whose passive turns every ability into a dash. Public Execution is an unstoppable, point-and-click engage that suppresses a backliner. Pros prioritize her as a mid-game skirmisher in top or jungle. Kiting ranged tops and lane bullies (Kennen, Tryndamere, Renekton) blunt her all-ins.

champions.name: Amumu
champions.title: the Sad Mummy
champions.notes: Simple, reliable AoE engage tank whose Bandage Toss into Curse of the Sad Mummy wins grouped teamfights and punishes clumped comps. He is weak early to invading junglers, and spell shields, cleanses and disengage (Morgana, Janna) waste his ult.

champions.name: Anivia
champions.title: the Cryophoenix
champions.notes: Zone-control mage with elite waveclear, a wall that splits fights and blocks dives, and an egg passive that makes her hard to kill. She scales into a teamfight anchor and bullies immobile melee tops. Long-range mages (Xerath, Syndra), Twisted Fate roams and Sylas stealing Glacial Storm give her trouble.

champions.name: Annie
champions.title: the Dark Child
champions.notes: Point-and-click burst mage whose Flash-Tibbers stun doubles as AoE engage. She is simple and strong into squishy or melee mids. Her short range means long-range mages outpoke her, and she needs frontline to reach fights.

champions.name: Aphelios
champions.title: the Weapon of the Faithful
champions.notes: Weapon-rotation hypercarry with huge AoE teamfight damage (Moonlight Vigil plus Infernum or Chakram) but no mobility. He needs peel or a lockdown support, is vulnerable in lane to bullies and poke mages, and gets hunted by divers.

champions.name: Ashe
champions.title: the Frost Archer
champions.notes: Utility marksman with permanent slows, a global Enchanted Crystal Arrow for picks or engage, and scouting Hawkshot, which makes her a reliable teamfight follow-up ADC. She has no mobility, so dive and short-range all-in lanes punish her.

champions.name: Aurelion Sol
champions.title: The Star Forger
champions.notes: Stardust-stacking late-game mage who flies over walls and melts teamfights with Breath of Light, Singularity and a knock-up ult. He is very weak early. Mobile assassins and melee all-ins (Yone, Fizz, Zed) exploit his lane, so he needs a safe lane and peel.

champions.name: Aurora
champions.title: the Witch Between Worlds
champions.notes: Mobile ranged mage who hops walls and traps enemies inside her Between Worlds zone. She kites melee champions well and flexes top and mid. Point-and-click engage and burst (Ambessa, Annie, Akali) and hard-pushing mages give her trouble.

champions.name: Azir
champions.title: the Emperor of the Sands
champions.notes: Late-scaling control mage with sustained soldier DPS, strong siege, and a Shurima Shuffle with Emperor's Divide that can peel or flip fights. He is weak early and hard to execute, and LeBlanc, long-range mages and roamers exploit his lane.

champions.name: Bard
champions.title: the Wandering Caretaker
champions.notes: Roaming playmaker support whose Cosmic Binding stuns against walls, while Magical Journey portals and Tempered Fate create picks or disengage. He is excellent in coordinated play and a pro staple, but he leaves his ADC exposed to 2v1 pressure from engage lanes.

champions.name: Bel'Veth
champions.title: the Empress of the Void
champions.notes: Attack-speed scaling jungler who snowballs off objectives (Void Coral) and shreds in extended skirmishes and side lanes. Point-and-click CC and early tank and CC junglers (Rammus, Sejuani) punish her. She needs frontline or engage to fight around.

champions.name: Blitzcrank
champions.title: the Great Steam Golem
champions.notes: Hook-based pick support whose Rocket Grab wins lanes and fights when it lands. Static Field silences, breaks shields and stops channels. He punishes immobile enchanters and mages but is unreliable against spell shields and tanky engage supports, and weaker once teams group and ward flanks.

champions.name: Brand
champions.title: the Burning Vengeance
champions.notes: Burn-based AoE mage whose Pyroclasm and Liandry's shred grouped teams and tanks, played as a damage support or mid. He is immobile and fragile, so hooks and hard engage punish him. He wants CC teammates to set up his combos.

champions.name: Braum
champions.title: the Heart of the Freljord
champions.notes: Top peel and disengage tank whose Unbreakable blocks projectiles and hooks, Concussive Blows stuns win lane trades, and Glacial Fissure stops dives. Pair him with fast-attacking ADCs. He is weak into sustained ranged poke he cannot close on.

champions.name: Briar
champions.title: the Restrained Hunger
champions.notes: Frenzied early-game diver with massive self-healing and a long-range fear engage (Certain Death). She snowballs through ganks but loses control in frenzy, so CC and kiting punish her, and she falls off if behind.

champions.name: Caitlyn
champions.title: the Sheriff of Piltover
champions.notes: Longest-range lane bully and siege ADC whose traps and headshots win lane and take early towers, which suits poke and siege comps. She pairs with root supports for trap setups. She falls behind hypercarries late and struggles in long fights against divers.

champions.name: Camille
champions.title: the Steel Shadow
champions.notes: Hookshot dive duelist who isolates a carry with Hextech Ultimatum and scales into a strong split pusher. She is also a pro-staple engage support. She beats immobile and tanky tops, while kiting, blinds and strong early lanes (Teemo, Renekton, Warwick, Gwen) give her trouble.

champions.name: Cassiopeia
champions.title: the Serpent's Embrace
champions.notes: Bootless DPS mage with enormous sustained damage, Miasma grounding against dashers and an AoE stun ult. She excels into melee and dash-heavy lanes, scales very well and is strong in pro. She is immobile, so she needs peel, and long-range mages and divers (Ekko, Qiyana, Fizz) beat her.

champions.name: Cho'Gath
champions.title: the Terror of the Void
champions.notes: Stacking tank whose true-damage Feast also secures objectives. Rupture knock-up and Feral Scream silence give solid teamfight CC. He scales into a huge frontline, but %HP and anti-tank champions (Urgot, Trundle, Vladimir) and kiting beat him.

champions.name: Corki
champions.title: the Daring Bombardier
champions.notes: Mixed-damage poke carry with Missile Barrage and The Package. He skirmishes well mid-game and is awkward to itemize against. Right now he is mostly a pro bot-lane pick. Caitlyn outranges him, and he loses long fights to hypercarries late.

champions.name: Darius
champions.title: the Hand of Noxus
champions.notes: Lane-dominant juggernaut who stacks Hemorrhage and chains Noxian Guillotine resets in teamfights. He is very strong early and mid game against melee tops. He is immobile, so ranged kiters (Quinn, Vayne), slows and disengage beat him, and he falls off late.

champions.name: Diana
champions.title: Scorn of the Moon
champions.notes: AP dive fighter whose Moonfall pulls enemies together for an AoE engage, and she bursts squishies after chaining Crescent Strike resets. She flexes mid and jungle. Kiting, fears (Vex) and strong early duelists beat her, and she wants AoE follow-up.

champions.name: Dr. Mundo
champions.title: the Madman of Zaun
champions.notes: Near-unkillable scaling tank who shrugs off a CC with his passive and regenerates huge HP with Maximum Dosage. He soaks side-lane pressure top or front-lines from the jungle, where he is a pro staple. Grievous Wounds and %HP or true-damage duelists (Aatrox, Gwen, Camille, Fiora) beat him.

champions.name: Draven
champions.title: the Glorious Executioner
champions.notes: One of the strongest lane-bully ADCs. Spinning Axe damage and Adoration cash-outs snowball games, and he is best with engage supports. He is a coin-flip carry who falls off if denied kills, and disengage, sustain and poke lanes stall him.

champions.name: Ekko
champions.title: the Boy Who Shattered Time
champions.notes: Time-rewinding AP skirmisher with fast clears and strong ganks in the jungle, burst and waveclear mid, and Chronobreak as a heal and escape. He excels against immobile mages. Point-and-click CC, fears and sustain like Vladimir's or Sylas's punish his dives.

champions.name: Elise
champions.title: the Spider Queen
champions.notes: Early-game gank and tower-dive specialist who lands Cocoon into spider-form burst and uses Rappel to dodge tower shots. She must snowball early and falls off. Early skirmishers (Talon, Diana) contest her, and scaling teams outlast her.

champions.name: Evelynn
champions.title: Agony's Embrace
champions.notes: Stealth assassin who hunts isolated squishies after level 6 and finishes fights with Last Caress. She is weak early, so invaders and early skirmishers punish her. Control Wards, Oracle Lens and grouped tanky comps neutralize her.

champions.name: Ezreal
champions.title: the Prodigal Explorer
champions.notes: Safe, mobile poke ADC with Arcane Shift and long-range Mystic Shot. He is a blind-pick staple in pro play and fits poke and siege comps. His sustained DPS is low late, and wind walls, projectile blockers and hard-shove waveclear lanes (Sivir) limit him.

champions.name: Fiddlesticks
champions.title: the Ancient Fear
champions.notes: Fog-of-war flanker whose Crowstorm blink wins teamfights on its own when it lands on a grouped team. He needs vision denial and patience. Control Wards, spread positioning and early invaders counter him.

champions.name: Fiora
champions.title: the Grand Duelist
champions.notes: One of the best split-push duelists. True damage on vitals and Riposte win 1v1s and take towers, and Grand Challenge heals her team in fights. Tanks and engage that ignore duels (Malphite, Shen) and kiting tops beat her. She needs a team that can play 4v4 or stall.

champions.name: Fizz
champions.title: the Tidal Trickster
champions.notes: AP melee assassin whose E (Playful/Trickster) dodges key spells and whose shark ult one-shots isolated carries from mid game. He is best into immobile artillery and control mages, and struggles into Vex fear, Kassadin, Vladimir and point-click CC.

champions.name: Galio
champions.title: the Colossus
champions.notes: Anti-magic tank mage whose Hero's Entrance follows a diving ally from across the map, while his W taunts a whole team. He is best into AP-heavy comps and with divers (Nocturne, J4, Vi). Control mages outscale and outrange him.

champions.name: Gangplank
champions.title: the Saltwater Scourge
champions.notes: Scaling barrel crit carry with global ult pressure. He wins by surviving lane, then side-laning and chunking whole teams with barrels. He struggles into durable tanks (Ornn, Mundo) and Kayle's scaling, and wants teammates with AoE lockdown to hold enemies on barrels.

champions.name: Garen
champions.title: The Might of Demacia
champions.notes: Simple, durable juggernaut with a silence, a spin and an execute ult. He is a strong solo-queue side laner who bullies melee duelists. Ranged tops (Quinn, Vayne, Teemo) kite him, Kayle outscales him, and he lacks hard engage or reliable CC for teamfights.

champions.name: Gnar
champions.title: the Missing Link
champions.notes: Mini Gnar is ranged and kites melee in lane, then Mega Gnar's ult into a wall is a game-winning multi-man engage. He needs rage management to time fights, and lane bullies punish his Mini form.

champions.name: Gragas
champions.title: the Rabble Rouser
champions.notes: Flex AP bruiser whose Body Slam and Explosive Cask move enemies into or out of fights, which makes him a top-tier disengage and a solid pick tool. He bullies scalers that are weak early (Kayle) and dash-reliant Yasuo. Tanky sustain tops (Urgot, Yorick, Mundo) out-trade him.

champions.name: Graves
champions.title: the Outlaw
champions.notes: Farm-heavy carry jungler who out-duels most skirmish junglers, then fights with high burst and bonus armor. He lacks CC, so he wants lanes that set up ganks. He struggles into armor-stacking tank junglers (Sejuani, Amumu, Rammus) and fast-scaling Karthus.

champions.name: Gwen
champions.title: The Hallowed Seamstress
champions.notes: AP skirmisher with true damage that melts tanks, and her Hallowed Mist blocks outside damage and turrets. She scales into a strong side-laner and teamfight DPS. Duelists like Yasuo and Jax and ranged tops trouble her, and she needs frontline or engage to reach targets.

champions.name: Hecarim
champions.title: the Shadow of War
champions.notes: Fast-clearing, high-speed diver whose E charge and fear ult run straight onto the backline. He loves enchanters with speed and shields, and Orianna ball deliveries. Dash-stoppers (Poppy W), taunts and knockback disengage shut him down.

champions.name: Heimerdinger
champions.title: the Revered Inventor
champions.notes: Turret-zone lane bully that punishes melee duelists who must walk into his turrets. He is strong at holding and sieging chokes. He is weak to tanks that shrug off turrets (Sion, Ornn, Malphite), Gangplank barrels and long-range artillery, and loses value in open-map late fights.

champions.name: Hwei
champions.title: the Visionary
champions.notes: Ten-spell control mage with long-range poke, root and fear picks, and a zoning ult. He flexes mid, support and bot and scales well. Pure artillery (Xerath, Vel'Koz) outranges him, and he is immobile against assassins and hard dive.

champions.name: Illaoi
champions.title: the Kraken Priestess
champions.notes: Immobile juggernaut who wins any fight on her tentacles, and her E (Test of Spirit) and ult punish enemies who dive her. She dominates 1v1 side lanes into melee tanks. Ranged kiters (Teemo, Vayne), Kayle and Mordekaiser's ult beat her.

champions.name: Irelia
champions.title: the Blade Dancer
champions.notes: Minion-reset duelist with elite mobility and a strong stun who snowballs through skirmishes once stacked. She wants lanes where she can trade freely. Dash-stoppers, grounding, point-click CC and tanky bruisers shut her down.

champions.name: Ivern
champions.title: the Green Father
champions.notes: Enchanter jungler whose shields, Daisy and root ganks enable hyper-carries instead of carrying himself. He wants a scaling DPS carry to protect and is very weak to early invades and counter-jungling.

champions.name: Janna
champions.title: the Storm's Fury
champions.notes: Top disengage enchanter whose tornado, shield and Monsoon undo dives and engages. She pairs with hyper-carry ADCs in protect-the-carry comps. She has low kill pressure, and other enchanters and hook supports slightly outvalue her in lane.

champions.name: Jarvan IV
champions.title: the Exemplar of Demacia
champions.notes: Pro-staple early-game engage jungler. He ganks with his EQ knock-up and traps enemies in Cataclysm for AoE follow-up (MF, Rumble, Orianna). He wants to snowball early objectives, falls off late, and is hard-stopped by Poppy W.

champions.name: Jax
champions.title: Grandmaster at Arms
champions.notes: Scaling hybrid duelist whose Counter Strike shuts down auto-attackers and melee duelists, and he becomes an elite split-pusher late. Poppy, Garen and ranged kiting tops (Kennen, Gnar) keep him down. He pulls pressure to side lanes instead of starting fights.

champions.name: Jayce
champions.title: the Defender of Tomorrow
champions.notes: Lane bully with elite Shock Blast poke who flexes top and mid and anchors poke and siege comps. He must convert early leads into towers and dragons because he falls off late and struggles into armor-stacking tanks (Malphite, Ornn) and Irelia.

champions.name: Jhin
champions.title: the Virtuoso
champions.notes: Utility marksman with long-range W root, 4th-shot burst and a curtain-call ult that picks off and finishes fights from afar. He pairs well with CC supports that enable his root. He is immobile, vulnerable to dive, and outscaled by hyper-carries like Zeri.

champions.name: Jinx
champions.title: the Loose Cannon
champions.notes: Hyper-carry ADC whose Get Excited resets turn one takedown into a teamfight wipe, and her rockets give siege range. She wants peel or enchanter supports and a frontline. She is immobile, so dive and assassins threaten her more than lane opponents do.

champions.name: K'Sante
champions.title: the Pride of Nazumah
champions.notes: Pro-favored tank with elite frontline and a flexible kit, including a Q3 knock-up, a W charge and an All Out ult that kicks a carry through a wall to isolate it. He is mechanically demanding and weak in solo queue. Kayle, true-damage duelists and sustain tanks beat him in lane.

champions.name: Kai'Sa
champions.title: Daughter of the Void
champions.notes: Hybrid-damage diving ADC who uses Killer Instinct to follow her support's CC and burst isolated targets with Icathian Rain. She is best with hard-engage supports. Hyper-carries with more range or attack speed (Zeri, Kog'Maw) outscale her.

champions.name: Kalista
champions.title: the Spear of Vengeance
champions.notes: Early-game lane bully with hop-kiting mobility, Rend objective control and a Fate's Call throw that turns her support into engage. She wants a hard-engage support and early skirmishes. She falls off hard and loses to scaling hyper-carries if the lead stalls.

champions.name: Karma
champions.title: the Enlightened One
champions.notes: Blind-pickable flex enchanter and poke mage whose Mantra Q poke dominates lane, while her team-wide shield and speed enable both disengage and engage. She is strongest early and loses value in late-game fights.

champions.name: Karthus
champions.title: the Deathsinger
champions.notes: Farming AP scaler with fast full clears, global Requiem and huge teamfight DPS, even after death. He is played in the jungle or as a bot-lane mage carry. He is very weak to early invades and dive, so he needs lanes that hold pressure.

champions.name: Kassadin
champions.title: the Void Walker
champions.notes: Hyper-scaling blink assassin who is miserable before level 6, then at 16 Riftwalk spam makes him nearly uncatchable and deadly to backlines. Draft him when the team can play for late game. Early lane bullies and roaming AD assassins punish him hard.

champions.name: Katarina
champions.title: the Sinister Blade
champions.notes: Reset assassin who cleans up fights with Shunpo and dagger resets and a channelled AoE ult. She needs teammates with AoE engage to start fights she can jump into, and point-click CC and interrupts hard-counter her.

champions.name: Kayle
champions.title: the Righteous
champions.notes: The most extreme late-game hyper-carry. She is a weak melee champion early, then at levels 11 and 16 gains ranged AoE DPS that shreds everyone. Draft her when the team can survive to late game. Early all-in bruisers and lane bullies punish her before level 6.

champions.name: Kayn
champions.title: the Shadow Reaper
champions.notes: Wall-walking jungler with two forms. Rhaast (against melee comps) is a sustain drain-tank bruiser, and Shadow Assassin (against ranged comps) is a pick and burst diver. He is weak before transforming, so strong early duelists (Bel'Veth, Wukong, Udyr) can deny his scaling.

champions.name: Kennen
champions.title: the Heart of the Tempest
champions.notes: Ranged AP top who kites melee duelists with shuriken poke, then flashes in with Slicing Maelstrom for an AoE stun engage. He is a great secondary engage for J4 or Orianna comps. He is fragile, and tanky laners (Illaoi, Ornn, Mundo) and Irelia out-sustain him.

champions.name: Kha'Zix
champions.title: the Voidreaver
champions.notes: Isolation-burst assassin jungler who counter-jungles and one-shots lone squishies, and his evolutions add stealth resets and mobility. He thrives against immobile comps that group poorly. Peel-heavy teams and tanky early junglers blunt him.

champions.name: Kindred
champions.title: The Eternal Hunters
champions.notes: Ranged marksman jungler who scales off marks from invades and brings Lamb's Respite, a team-wide ult that stops dives and deaths. She needs early control to stack marks. Tanky early duelists (Wukong, Rammus, Sejuani) and Kayn punish her.

champions.name: Kled
champions.title: the Cantankerous Cavalier
champions.notes: Aggressive all-in top laner with a bear-trap pull, a second life from dismounting and remounting, and a long-range Chaaaaaaaarge ult that drags the team into fights. He wants to snowball early and dive, and falls off if the lane stalls.

champions.name: Kog'Maw
champions.title: the Mouth of the Abyss
champions.notes: Immobile hyper-carry whose Bio-Arcane Barrage %HP on-hit shreds frontline at long range, and he outscales early bullies like Kalista. He is the classic protect-the-carry pick (Lulu, Janna, Ivern) and dies to dive and assassins.

champions.name: LeBlanc
champions.title: the Deceiver
champions.notes: Slippery burst mage and assassin who deletes squishies with Distortion trades, chain root picks and Mimic double-combos, then escapes. She is a strong mid-game roamer for pick comps. She falls off late and is countered by Malzahar, Vex, point-click CC and MR tanks.

champions.name: Lee Sin
champions.title: the Blind Monk
champions.notes: Early-game playmaker who invades, ganks and Insec-kicks a carry into his team. He must snowball before tanks and scalers come online, and he falls off late. Zaahen, Naafiri and Rek'Sai match his early skirmishing, and Taliyah and Ivern out-tempo his ganks.

champions.name: Leona
champions.title: the Radiant Dawn
champions.notes: All-in engage support with a point-and-click stun chain and a wide R. She wins lane at level 2 or 3 and sets up picks for the team. She wants a follow-up ADC (Samira, MF, Kalista). She hates Janna and Black Shield, and Swain, Renata and Soraka lanes out-sustain her.

champions.name: Lillia
champions.title: the Bashful Bloom
champions.notes: Fast-clearing, kiting magic-damage jungler whose AoE sleep R turns messy teamfights. She is strong into tank junglers and melee comps but vulnerable to early invaders (Rengar, Rek'Sai, Kha'Zix). She needs frontline or engage allies so she can run circles around the fight.

champions.name: Lissandra
champions.title: the Ice Witch
champions.notes: Anti-dive control mage whose point-and-click R, E flanks and W root lock down assassins and divers, then chain into team engage. She is excellent into melee mids. Artillery and control mages (Hwei, Viktor, Xerath) outrange her, and Sylas steals her R.

champions.name: Locke
champions.title: the Ashen Exorcist
champions.notes: Melee AP on-hit assassin (Lich Bane) with a blink-dash E and a Purgatory R that executes and permanently raises its threshold per seal. Feasts on immobile ranged mages (Malzahar, Orianna, Xerath) but has no hard CC and loses to other melee assassins (Akali, Talon, Kassadin).

champions.name: Lucian
champions.title: the Purifier
champions.notes: Short-range lane bully with a dash-reset combo who wants to win lane with an aggressive enchanter (Nami, Milio) or Braum and take early towers. He loses value late against hypercarries and struggles into APC mage bots (Seraphine, Brand) and long-range poke (Varus, Caitlyn).

champions.name: Lulu
champions.title: the Fae Sorceress
champions.notes: Top peel enchanter whose polymorph, shields and Wild Growth knock-up keep a hypercarry alive through dives. Draft her with an on-hit scaling carry (Kog'Maw, Twitch, Jinx). She handles engage and mage supports well, but Bard out-roams her and picks from Fiddlesticks, Elise and Zoe punish her.

champions.name: Lux
champions.title: the Lady of Luminosity
champions.notes: Long-range poke and pick mage who lands a double-root binding into a long-range R execute. She is best in poke or pick comps with follow-up (Caitlyn traps). She is immobile, so assassins (Locke, Zed), hooks and engage supports like Camille and Pantheon punish her.

champions.name: Malphite
champions.title: Shard of the Monolith
champions.notes: Point-and-click wombo engage with Unstoppable Force. Armor stacking and his attack-speed slow crush auto-attack tops (Tryndamere, Vayne, Irelia). He is weak into AP and sustained tanks he cannot kill (Sylas, Mundo, Gwen, Mordekaiser, Shen).

champions.name: Malzahar
champions.title: the Prophet of the Void
champions.notes: Safe, push-heavy control mage whose point-and-click suppression R locks down one carry or diver. He is great into dash assassins and carries (LeBlanc, Zoe, Yasuo, Master Yi). Artillery mages and Smolder outrange him, Locke dives him, and Olaf and QSS ignore his R.

champions.name: Maokai
champions.title: the Twisted Treant
champions.notes: Flexible tank with point-and-click root, sapling vision control and a long-range root wave that both starts and stops fights. He has low damage, so he needs carries to follow up. He loses lane to Zilean, Taric, Braum and Swain, and Nocturne dives him in the jungle.

champions.name: Master Yi
champions.title: the Wuju Bladesman
champions.notes: Farming hypercarry jungler whose resets win late fights against low-CC comps. He needs a free early game and enchanter support. Point-and-click CC (Malzahar R, Rammus taunt), Lulu polymorph and early pressure from Zac, Rek'Sai and Elise punish him.

champions.name: Mel
champions.title: the Soul's Reflection
champions.notes: Scaling artillery mage whose Overwhelm stacks execute and whose global R finishes anyone marked. Her W reflects projectiles, which punishes skillshot ults and ranged poke. She is weak in every role right now. Aurelion Sol, Syndra and Viktor out-trade her, and Fizz and Locke dive her once W is down.

champions.name: Milio
champions.title: The Gentle Flame
champions.notes: Enchanter whose W extends ally attack range and whose R cleanses CC and heals the whole team. He out-sustains mage and Morgana lanes. Pair him with range-hungry carries (Jinx, Kog'Maw, Zeri). He is fragile against hooks and all-in engage (Blitzcrank, Nautilus, Amumu).

champions.name: Miss Fortune
champions.title: the Bounty Hunter
champions.notes: Lane-bully ADC with bouncing Q poke and a Bullet Time R that deletes grouped teams. Draft her with AoE lockdown (Amumu, Rell, Malphite, Leona) so she can channel R safely. She struggles into APC mages (Viktor, Ziggs, Corki), and Braum E or dive that interrupts R shuts her down.

champions.name: Mordekaiser
champions.title: the Iron Revenant
champions.notes: Immobile AP juggernaut whose Realm of Death isolates a carry 1v1 and turns fights into 4v4. He bullies tanks and immobile bruisers (Illaoi, Tahm, Malphite). Vayne and Singed kite him and Yone, Gwen and Fiora outplay him, so he needs teammates who win the 4v4.

champions.name: Morgana
champions.title: the Fallen
champions.notes: Anti-engage pick support whose Black Shield denies hooks and CC chains, while a long Dark Binding catches targets. She hard-counters CC-reliant engage supports. She loses lane to enchanters and poke-sustain lanes (Karma, Milio, Janna, Yuumi) and Shaco.

champions.name: Naafiri
champions.title: the Hound of a Hundred Bites
champions.notes: Lethality pack-assassin with a point-and-click dash onto champions and a roaming R. She excels at hunting isolated squishies and out-skirmishes Lee Sin and Kha'Zix early. She falls off against tanky comps and loses to sturdier divers (Hecarim, Nocturne, Bel'Veth, Xin Zhao).

champions.name: Nami
champions.title: the Tidecaller
champions.notes: Aggressive enchanter whose bubble, empowered E trades and Tidal Wave give lane pressure, heals, and engage or disengage in teamfights. She is best with multi-hit lane bullies (Lucian, Draven). She beats mage supports but is vulnerable to hard engage (Nautilus, Amumu) and anti-heal.

champions.name: Nasus
champions.title: the Curator of the Sands
champions.notes: Stacking juggernaut who is weak early, then Siphoning Strike and Fury of the Sands make him a tanky split-pusher and tower-taker. Wither shuts down auto-attack carries. His current sustain lets him survive old ranged-top counters (Vayne, Kennen), and durable duelists like K'Sante, Ambessa and Camille handle him best.

champions.name: Nautilus
champions.title: the Titan of the Depths
champions.notes: Tanky hook engage support with a point-and-click R and an auto-attack root. He all-ins and picks off squishy mage and enchanter supports. He pairs with all-in ADCs (Samira, Kalista, Draven, Nilah). He loses tank-vs-tank lanes (Taric, Rell, Braum), and Black Shield blunts him.

champions.name: Neeko
champions.title: the Curious Chameleon
champions.notes: Disguise-based engage mage with a long root E and a flash-in Pop Blossom AoE stun that wins grouped fights. She needs follow-up AoE (MF, Seraphine) and is predictable once spotted. She beats other engage supports, but Karma and Zyra poke her out and Black Shield blunts her.

champions.name: Nidalee
champions.title: the Bestial Huntress
champions.notes: High-tempo early jungler with a fast clear, invades, and long-range spear poke into cougar burst. She must convert early leads, falls off late, and struggles into tanky, CC-heavy junglers and comps that hard-engage onto her.

champions.name: Nilah
champions.title: the Joy Unbound
champions.notes: Melee skirmish carry who dodges auto attacks with W, shares heals and shields, and pulls enemies in with R. She needs hard-engage or enchanter supports to reach targets. She beats auto-attack ADCs (Twitch, Kalista, MF) but is hard-countered by Xayah and ranged mage bots (Corki, Viktor).

champions.name: Nocturne
champions.title: the Eternal Nightmare
champions.notes: Map-wide diver whose Paranoia removes vision and lets him drop on an isolated carry, with spell shield and fear for the kill. He combos with global or flank follow-up (TF, Galio, Lissandra). He is weak when enemies group tightly and into sturdy early duelists (Ambessa, Udyr, Skarner).

champions.name: Nunu & Willump
champions.title: the Boy and His Yeti
champions.notes: Roaming tank jungler whose Consume secures objectives and heals, while the snowball roll ganks from long range. He brings engage, frontline and objective control instead of damage, and loses tempo to strong early skirmishers and kiting junglers.

champions.name: Olaf
champions.title: the Berserker
champions.notes: Early-game berserker with true-damage E, lifesteal W and a CC-immune R that runs straight at carries. He dominates early skirmishes and CC-heavy comps, falls off late, and gets kited by ranged or mobile laners.

champions.name: Orianna
champions.title: the Lady of Clockwork
champions.notes: Scaling control mage whose Shockwave wins teamfights once the ball is on a diver, while shields and Dissonance peel carries. She wants engage teammates to deliver the ball (Malphite, J4, Wukong). She is weak in lane against Locke, Irelia and long-range poke (Zoe, Vel'Koz, Xerath).

champions.name: Ornn
champions.title: The Fire below the Mountain
champions.notes: Scaling frontline tank with knock-up engage (R and E) and free item upgrades for his team. He plays safe in lane, then anchors teamfights. K'Sante, Fiora and Ambessa out-duel and split-push him.

champions.name: Pantheon
champions.title: the Unbreakable Spear
champions.notes: Flexible early-game bully with a point-and-click stun leap, spear poke and a global R for skirmishes and roams. He must snowball the lane or map early. He falls off late and struggles against tanky or sustain lanes (Soraka, Taric, Rell, Mundo).

champions.name: Poppy
champions.title: Keeper of the Hammer
champions.notes: Anti-dive tank whose Steadfast Presence grounds dashes, Heroic Charge wall-stuns and Keeper's Verdict knocks divers away. She hard-counters dash-reliant champions (Irelia, Jax, Kalista, Yasuo, Lee). She has low damage and loses lanes to sustain or poke supports and juggernauts (Darius, Olaf).

champions.name: Pyke
champions.title: the Bloodharbor Ripper
champions.notes: Assassin support whose hook, stun dash and resetting execute R snowball through picks and roams. He preys on immobile mage supports (Lux, Xerath, Vel'Koz). He gives no frontline or peel, and engage and disengage supports (Renata, Camille, Rakan, Nautilus) blunt him.

champions.name: Qiyana
champions.title: Empress of the Elements
champions.notes: Elemental burst assassin whose terrain-based R stuns whole teams near walls, rivers and brush. She deletes immobile squishies and enables wombo follow-up. She needs terrain and leads, and folds to dash denial (Poppy), Malphite's armor and early skirmishing from Rengar and Nidalee.

champions.name: Quinn
champions.title: Demacia's Wings
champions.notes: Ranged lethality skirmisher played in the jungle or top. She bullies melee laners, then uses Behind Enemy Lines for fast rotations, picks and split pressure. She falls off late and is fragile into armor tanks and point-and-click engage.

champions.name: Rakan
champions.title: The Charmer
champions.notes: Mobile engage and peel support whose Grand Entrance knockup and The Quickness charm start fights, while Battle Dance dashes to shield allies. He is best with Xayah and AoE follow-up (Yasuo, Orianna). He struggles into Neeko, long-range Senna, and dash-stoppers and disengage (Poppy, Janna).

champions.name: Rammus
champions.title: the Armordillo
champions.notes: Tank jungler who ganks with Powerball and taunts, and whose Defensive Ball Curl punishes auto-attack divers (Rengar, Yi, Tryndamere). He is weaker into kiting or early-duel junglers (Lillia, Rek'Sai, Trundle) and wants magic-damage allies and follow-up for his engage.

champions.name: Rek'Sai
champions.title: the Void Burrower
champions.notes: Early tunnel ganker with an Unburrow knockup and a long-range Void Rush execute, who wants to snowball side lanes before tanks outscale her. She beats Rammus, Kayn and Briar early but struggles into Sejuani and hard-CC tank junglers.

champions.name: Rell
champions.title: the Iron Maiden
champions.notes: Hard-engage tank support whose Crash Down knockup, Full Tilt stun and Magnet Storm pull make her one of the best teamfight initiators. She pairs with AoE follow-up (Miss Fortune, Orianna, Samira). She is weak into drain and disengage supports (Swain, Janna, Neeko) and Poppy W.

champions.name: Renata Glasc
champions.title: the Chem-Baroness
champions.notes: Utility enchanter whose Bailout revives aggressive carries and whose Hostile Takeover turns a diving or clumped enemy team on itself. She is good against Pyke and all-in lanes, and long-range mage supports (Vel'Koz, Xerath) and Lulu bully her.

champions.name: Renekton
champions.title: the Butcher of the Sands
champions.notes: Lane-bully bruiser with a double dash and an empowered W stun, who wants to win lane and turn it into early dives with his jungler. He falls off late and struggles into sustain and scaling tops (Dr. Mundo, Illaoi, Gangplank), Vayne and Teemo.

champions.name: Rengar
champions.title: the Pridestalker
champions.notes: Bush-leaping one-shot assassin that snowballs picks on squishy carries and squishy junglers. Tanky taunt and CC junglers (Rammus, Sejuani) and Poppy W hard-counter him, and he needs an early lead to matter.

champions.name: Riven
champions.title: the Exile
champions.notes: High-skill mobile skirmisher with animation-cancel burst and a strong split-push, who beats immobile bruisers and tanks (Sett, Sion, Yasuo, Gwen). Ranged and stun tops (Kennen, Vayne) and sustain juggernauts (Illaoi, Singed) counter her.

champions.name: Rumble
champions.title: the Mechanized Menace
champions.notes: Mech-mage teamfighter whose Flamespitter wins trades against melee while The Equalizer zones whole fights. He is a high-priority pro flex (top, jungle, mid) who wants CC to lock enemies in his ult. He struggles into Kayle, Gragas and Tahm Kench, and is a weak blind pick in solo queue.

champions.name: Ryze
champions.title: the Rune Mage
champions.notes: Scaling battlemage with high sustained single-target DPS and Realm Warp for team flanks and escapes. He is a pro staple but weak in solo-queue lanes. He needs time and items, and mobile mids (Irelia, Qiyana, Zoe) bully him.

champions.name: Samira
champions.title: the Desert Rose
champions.notes: All-in hypercarry who builds Style to unleash Inferno Trigger, and wants hard-engage supports (Nautilus, Leona, Rell, Rakan) and knockups. Wind Wall eats projectiles, but long-range and drain mages (Swain, Veigar) kite her and interrupts (Janna, Poppy) stop her.

champions.name: Sejuani
champions.title: Fury of the North
champions.notes: Tank engage jungler with Glacial Prison and a frost-stun passive. She is a reliable teamfight initiator and anti-dive frontline who loves melee-heavy allies. She beats snowball assassin junglers (Rengar, Rek'Sai, Kindred, Shaco) and is weak to kiting magic junglers (Lillia, Diana) and Trundle.

champions.name: Senna
champions.title: the Redeemer
champions.notes: Scaling ranged support or carry who collects Mist for infinite range and AD, heals with Piercing Darkness and shields globally with Dawning Shadow. She wants long-range ADCs. She is vulnerable to point-and-click engage (Nautilus), and Xerath outranges her.

champions.name: Seraphine
champions.title: the Starry-Eyed Songstress
champions.notes: Scaling teamfight mage (support or bot) with long-range Encore charm engage, an AoE shield and heal, and solid waveclear. She needs frontline to cast behind. Dive and hook supports, Sivir's spell shield and Yasuo's Wind Wall punish her.

champions.name: Sett
champions.title: the Boss
champions.notes: Early and mid-game juggernaut with a true-damage Haymaker and The Show Stopper suplex engage. He bullies melee lanes and starts fights. Ranged tops (Vayne, Ryze) kite him, Riven outplays him, and he falls off against late-game scalers.

champions.name: Shaco
champions.title: the Demon Jester
champions.notes: Invade-heavy trickster (AD jungle, occasionally AP support) with stealth, Jack in the Box fears and a clone. He snowballs early and picks off carries, but falls off late. Tanky CC junglers (Sejuani) and strong early duelists counter him.

champions.name: Shen
champions.title: the Eye of Twilight
champions.notes: Global-presence tank whose Stand United shields an ally and joins fights anywhere while he split-pushes. Shadow Dash taunts to engage, and Spirit's Refuge blocks autos. He is good against Fiora, Yorick and tanks, and struggles into Quinn, Singed and extended-trade bruisers (Olaf, Sett, Tryndamere).

champions.name: Shyvana
champions.title: the Half-Dragon
champions.notes: Bruiser-tank dragon, reworked in 26.6, who farms Scalemail defensive stacks, then engages with the fear-leap Dragon's Descent and brawls with empowered abilities. She needs farm and time. Sylas hard-counters her by stealing her ult, and she is weak into Ivern and Udyr.

champions.name: Singed
champions.title: the Mad Chemist
champions.notes: Proxy-farming split-pusher who drags enemies into chases with Poison Trail and flings targets into his team. He frustrates melee tops (Yasuo, Mordekaiser, Riven, Jax) and is weak into ranged or burst scalers (Gangplank, Kayle, Kennen).

champions.name: Sion
champions.title: The Undead Juggernaut
champions.notes: Scaling HP-stacking tank with long-range Unstoppable Onslaught engage, a Decimating Smash knockup and a strong side-wave shove. He is a pro-play staple. His lane is weak against Riven, Yone, Shen and true-damage or ranged tops (Zaahen, Quinn, Gwen).

champions.name: Sivir
champions.title: the Battle Mistress
champions.notes: Waveclear and siege ADC with Spell Shield and team-wide On The Hunt speed, which enables fast pushes, engages and disengages. She is strong into mage and poke bots (Seraphine, Vel'Koz, Veigar), and Kog'Maw and Twitch out-DPS her late.

champions.name: Skarner
champions.title: the Primordial Sovereign
champions.notes: Tank jungler whose Impale suppresses and drags carries into his team, with Ixtal's Impact wall-stun charges for engage. He is a strong pick and anti-dive tool against Nocturne, Graves and Sylas, and weak to kiting and duelist junglers (Udyr, Gwen, Lillia).

champions.name: Smolder
champions.title: the Fiery Fledgling
champions.notes: Stack-scaling dragon ADC with a quiet lane, then huge AoE waveclear and max-HP executes against tanks at high stacks. He needs enchanter protection (Lulu, Milio) and time. Long-range mage bots (Lux, Ziggs, Vel'Koz), Twitch and Zeri out-trade him.

champions.name: Sona
champions.title: Maven of the Strings
champions.notes: Scaling aura enchanter with heals, team speed and an AoE Crescendo stun, and strong value in late teamfights. She is fragile and immobile, so she needs a bot laner who can hold early pressure and frontline to protect her.

champions.name: Soraka
champions.title: the Starchild
champions.notes: Top sustain enchanter whose Astral Infusion heals and global Wish negate poke and extend fights, while Equinox silences. She is great against poke and all-in comps that can't burst through heals. Grievous Wounds counters her, and Senna and Nami out-trade her.

champions.name: Swain
champions.title: the Noxian Grand General
champions.notes: Drain-tank battlemage (mostly support or bot, also mid and top) with a Nevermove pull-root and Demonic Ascension sustain. He wins brawls against melee and all-in lanes (Rell, Leona, Nautilus, Samira). Long-range mages and enchanters (Syndra, Zeri, Nami, Karma) kite him.

champions.name: Sylas
champions.title: the Unshackled
champions.notes: Skirmish mage (jungle or mid) who steals enemy ultimates, so his value grows with the enemy's ults, and he hard-counters Malphite and Shyvana. He struggles into Taliyah, Gwen, Skarner, Pantheon and drain or anti-dash champions.

champions.name: Syndra
champions.title: the Dark Sovereign
champions.notes: Burst and control mage (mid, also bot) with a Scatter the Weak stun and a point-and-click Unleashed Power execute, which give her a strong pick threat and lane control. She is vulnerable to mobile assassins that dive past her stun (Fizz, Katarina, Locke).

champions.name: Tahm Kench
champions.title: The River King
champions.notes: Peel tank (support or top) whose Devour saves carries, and his grey-health bulk makes him a strong anti-assassin frontline. He beats melee and short-range tops (Irelia, Jayce, Rumble) and is weak to tanky scalers (Sion, Ornn, Singed) and Gwen's true damage.

champions.name: Taliyah
champions.title: the Stoneweaver
champions.notes: Roaming waveclear mage (mid or jungle) whose Weaver's Wall splits fights and enables roams, while Seismic Shove and Unraveled Earth punish dashers. She is strong against Yasuo and Sylas, and weak to assassins (Zed, Katarina, Kassadin, LeBlanc) and long-range Xerath.

champions.name: Talon
champions.title: the Blade's Shadow
champions.notes: Roaming AD assassin with wall-hop parkour who snowballs early picks from jungle or mid and punishes squishy carries. He falls off late and is weak against Rengar, Fiddlesticks and mobile or CC mids (Ekko, Qiyana, Azir).

champions.name: Taric
champions.title: the Shield of Valoran
champions.notes: Tank-enchanter for protect and dive comps, whose Cosmic Radiance invulnerability and linked Dazzle stuns enable all-ins and dives (Master Yi, Kai'Sa). His lane is weak into ranged, poke and anti-engage supports (Senna, Milio, Morgana).

champions.name: Teemo
champions.title: the Swift Scout
champions.notes: Ranged top that blinds auto-attackers (Vayne, Volibear, Renekton, Camille) and zones with Noxious Traps. He split-pushes well but teamfights poorly. Tanky engage and magic damage (Olaf, Sion, Ryze, Akali) counter him.

champions.name: Thresh
champions.title: the Chain Warden
champions.notes: Pick-and-peel playmaker whose Death Sentence hooks and Flay engage, while his Dark Passage lantern saves or repositions allies. He fits almost any comp and is best with Kalista or Draven. Mage supports (Brand) and spell shields blunt his hooks.

champions.name: Tristana
champions.title: the Yordle Gunner
champions.notes: Scaling siege ADC with Rocket Jump resets, a tower-shredding Explosive Charge and self-peel from Buster Shot. She can all-in with engage supports. She is strong into immobile mage bots (Vel'Koz, Xerath) and struggles against Nilah and drain or burst mages (Karthus, Veigar, Vladimir).

champions.name: Trundle
champions.title: the Troll King
champions.notes: Early-duel tank-killer whose Chomp and Subjugate steal AD and resistances, while Pillar isolates targets. He is excellent into tank-heavy comps and as a side-lane and skirmish threat. He struggles against ranged kiters (Vayne, Teemo, Quinn) and falls off against scaled carries.

champions.name: Tryndamere
champions.title: the Barbarian King
champions.notes: Crit split-pusher whose Undying Rage makes him unkillable for 5 seconds. He wins through 1-3-1 side pressure that forces two players to answer him. Armor and attack-speed-slow tanks (Malphite), Nasus Wither and point-click CC hard-counter him, and he adds almost no teamfight utility.

champions.name: Twisted Fate
champions.title: the Card Master
champions.notes: Global pick mage whose Destiny and Gold Card let him collapse on side lanes and turn cross-map skirmishes, with strong waveclear to free his lane. He needs follow-up (Nocturne, Galio) and lane priority. He loses 1v1 all-ins to Kassadin, Fizz and Yasuo, and spell shields blank him.

champions.name: Twitch
champions.title: the Plague Rat
champions.notes: Stealth scaling hypercarry who ambushes out of Camouflage and melts front-to-back fights with Spray and Pray's piercing range. He wants an enchanter (Lulu, Yuumi) and peel. He is weak early and to Windwall, Braum and hard dive.

champions.name: Udyr
champions.title: the Spirit Walker
champions.notes: Stance-swapping juggernaut with fast full clears, strong early duels and run-down ganks via Blazing Stampede's stun. He wants skirmishes and a front-to-back fight. Kiting or ranged comps and scaled carries beat him.

champions.name: Urgot
champions.title: the Dreadnought
champions.notes: Ranged juggernaut who wins extended fights with Purge and shotgun-knee passive, flips targets with Disdain and executes with Fear Beyond Death. He beats short-range melee bruisers (Darius, Aatrox) and struggles against armor-stacking tanks and ranged kiting tops.

champions.name: Varus
champions.title: the Arrow of Retribution
champions.notes: Long-range poke marksman, built lethality or on-hit. Piercing Arrow sieges, Chain of Corruption starts picks and fights, and Hail of Arrows applies Grievous Wounds. He is a pro staple for poke and pick comps (Karma, Jayce), and weaker in hard all-in lanes and against hyper-scalers late.

champions.name: Vayne
champions.title: the Night Hunter
champions.notes: Tank-shredding hypercarry whose Silver Bolts true damage and stealth from Tumble and Final Hour make her a late-game 1v5 threat and a duelist top. She has a weak early lane and short range. She needs peel and enchanters (Lulu, Janna), and falls to hard CC, burst and ranged bullies.

champions.name: Veigar
champions.title: the Tiny Master of Evil
champions.notes: Infinitely scaling burst mage who stacks AP from farming and one-shots carries with Primordial Burst, while Event Horizon zones divers. He is weak early and to mobile assassins (Katarina, LeBlanc). He pairs with AoE engage that shoves enemies into the cage.

champions.name: Vel'Koz
champions.title: the Eye of the Void
champions.notes: Artillery mage with the longest reliable poke and a true-damage passive that also punishes tanks, and his Life Form Disintegration Ray shreds grouped teams. He is immobile, so he needs frontline or disengage and loses to hooks (Blitzcrank) and assassins that reach him.

champions.name: Vex
champions.title: the Gloomist
champions.notes: Anti-mobility burst mage whose Gloom punishes dashes, while Personal Space and her Doom passive fear divers. That makes her one of the best counters to Yasuo, Yone, LeBlanc and Akali. She has good waveclear and R follow-up on picks. Immobile artillery mages (Xerath, Hwei) outrange her, and Vladimir out-sustains her.

champions.name: Vi
champions.title: the Piltover Enforcer
champions.notes: Dive and pick jungler whose Cease and Desist is an unstoppable point-and-click lockdown on the priority carry, great for starting fights and securing picks. She has strong gank pressure. She is weaker into peel and kite comps and early duelists (Warwick, Zac).

champions.name: Viego
champions.title: The Ruined King
champions.notes: Reset-based skirmisher who possesses kills to chain fights and heal, snowballing messy teamfights. He needs early leads and chaotic fights. He struggles against early duelists (Warwick), heavy chain CC and disciplined front-to-back comps.

champions.name: Viktor
champions.title: the Herald of the Arcane
champions.notes: Scaling control mage whose Hextech Ray waveclear and poke, Gravity Field zone-stun and Arcane Storm give strong teamfight zone control once his Hex Fragment augments come online. He also flexes bot as a lane-bully mage. He is immobile, so longer-range mages (Xerath) and assassins threaten him.

champions.name: Vladimir
champions.title: the Crimson Reaper
champions.notes: Self-sustaining AP scaler whose Transfusion healing and Sanguine Pool make him hard to kill, and Hemoplague bursts grouped enemies late. He is weak in the early levels before 6. He hates Grievous Wounds, long-range control mages (Malzahar) and early lane bullies in top lane.

champions.name: Volibear
champions.title: the Relentless Storm
champions.notes: Early-game dive juggernaut whose Thundering Smash stun, Frenzied Maul healing and Stormbringer tower-disable let him dive backlines and towers. He snowballs early, is weak to kiting ranged tops (Teemo, Quinn) and scales poorly.

champions.name: Warwick
champions.title: the Uncaged Wrath of Zaun
champions.notes: Drain-tank early ganker whose Blood Hunt tracks low-HP targets and whose Infinite Duress suppresses a carry for follow-up. He wins early duels and 2v2s with self-healing. He falls off late and hates Grievous Wounds, Rammus and kiting junglers.

champions.name: Wukong
champions.title: the Monkey King
champions.notes: Bruiser-diver whose double-cast Cyclone knocks up clumped enemies, with strong ganks from W stealth and E dash. He combos with knock-up follow-up (Yasuo, Yone) and wombo mages, and wants engage angles instead of kiting comps.

champions.name: Xayah
champions.title: the Rebel
champions.notes: Teamfight marksman with built-in anti-dive. Featherstorm's untargetability and Bladecaller's feather root punish divers and all-ins (Samira, Kai'Sa). She is best with Rakan. Jinx outscales her, and long-range mages (Hwei, Lux) poke her out.

champions.name: Xerath
champions.title: the Magus Ascendant
champions.notes: Top artillery mage whose extreme-range poke and Rite of the Arcane siege objectives and whittle teams down before fights. He is immobile and squishy, so he needs frontline or disengage and lane priority. Assassins (Fizz, Katarina, Kassadin) and engage supports punish him hard.

champions.name: Xin Zhao
champions.title: the Seneschal of Demacia
champions.notes: Early skirmish diver whose Audacious Charge engage, Three Talon Strike knockup and Crescent Guard (which blocks ranged damage) win early fights and dives. Pros favor him as a ball-carrier for Orianna. He falls off late and loses to strong early duelists (Udyr, Sylas).

champions.name: Yasuo
champions.title: the Unforgiven
champions.notes: Crit skirmisher with double crit chance, a Wind Wall that blocks projectiles and a Last Breath that works off any airborne effect. Draft knock-ups with him (Malphite, Yone, Wukong, Alistar). Point-click and anti-dash control (Vex, Lissandra, Taliyah) and early armor bullies counter him.

champions.name: Yone
champions.title: the Unforgotten
champions.notes: Mixed-damage crit skirmisher whose Spirit Cleave dashes and knockups and Fate Sealed give AoE engage, while Soul Unbound lets him dive and return. He is hard to itemize against. Anti-dash control (Vex) and early duelists (Irelia, Olaf, Jax) counter him.

champions.name: Yorick
champions.title: Shepherd of Souls
champions.notes: Side-lane siege engine whose ghouls and Maiden of the Mist shred towers and win 1v1s, which forces multiple defenders. His team should play 4v4 with waveclear or disengage. He is weak to duelists with AoE clear (Yone, Gwen) and to Shen's cross-map answers.

champions.name: Yunara
champions.title: the Unbroken Faith
champions.notes: On-hit and crit scaling marksman with hybrid damage from magic on-hit. Cultivation of Spirit splashes attacks into grouped enemies, and Transcend upgrades her W laser and turns her E into a dash. She is weak to dive when R is down and to early lane bullies. She wants peel or enchanters and front-to-back fights.

champions.name: Yuumi
champions.title: the Magical Cat
champions.notes: Attach-and-heal enchanter who is untargetable while attached and gives heals, move speed and stats to a hypercarry. She has weak lane presence and low CC, and loses to engage supports (Alistar, Thresh) and Grievous Wounds. She is best on scaling on-hit carries.

champions.name: Zaahen
champions.title: The Unsundered
champions.notes: Darkin drain-juggernaut who wins long fights. Determination stacks grant AD and eventually a revive, and his Q and R heal him. His Q-recast knockup and W pull give catch. He bullies at level 1 and scales into an unkillable late-game frontline. Ranged kiting tops (Teemo, Vayne, Quinn) that keep trades short beat him.

champions.name: Zac
champions.title: the Secret Weapon
champions.notes: Long-range engage tank whose Elastic Slingshot starts fights from fog and over walls, while blob heals and a passive revive keep him in the fight. He is one of the best engages for AoE follow-up comps. He is weak to Grievous Wounds, kiting and junglers who invade or duel early.

champions.name: Zed
champions.title: the Master of Shadows
champions.notes: Shadow assassin whose Death Mark one-shots isolated squishies, while shadows give elusive side-lane pressure. He wins through picks and split-pushing. He is poor into tanky or armor-stacking comps (Malphite), Zhonya's and point-click lockdown.

champions.name: Zeri
champions.title: The Spark of Zaun
champions.notes: Hyper-mobile scaling marksman whose Spark Surge wall-hops and Lightning Crash move speed let her kite and chain fights. She needs enchanter support (Lulu, Yuumi) and farm. Her early lane is weak against bullies, and hard CC punishes her.

champions.name: Ziggs
champions.title: the Hexplosives Expert
champions.notes: Siege artillery mage whose Satchel Charge and Hexplosive bombs demolish towers and waves, while Mega Inferno Bomb pokes from across the map. He wins by taking objectives early. He needs frontline or disengage, and assassins and hard dive punish him.

champions.name: Zilean
champions.title: the Chronokeeper
champions.notes: Utility mage whose double-bomb AoE stun, Time Warp speed or slow and Chronoshift revive make him a flexible support for peel, disengage and chasing. Chronoshift blanks assassin burst on the carry. He scales with levels and wants a hypercarry to protect.

champions.name: Zoe
champions.title: the Aspect of Twilight
champions.notes: Long-range burst and pick mage whose Sleepy Trouble Bubble into Paddle Star one-shots squishies and wins sieges through fog. She has a high skill ceiling. She is weak to divers and assassins, to Malzahar and Annie in lane, and to tanky comps she can't burst.

champions.name: Zyra
champions.title: Rise of the Thorns
champions.notes: Plant-mage zone controller whose Grasping Roots and plants poke and punish melee, while Stranglethorns is a strong AoE knockup and zone in teamfights. She is also a fast-clearing jungler with good ganks. She is immobile and vulnerable to hooks and hard engage.
